title: Meridian Studio dataset
description: Meridian's CsvDataLoader arguments; `csv` stands for csv_path.

csv.description: The CSV, relative to the project or absolute. Dates in the time column read yyyy-mm-dd.

kpi_type.description: revenue: the KPI is money. non_revenue: units, with revenue_per_kpi to read results in money (ROI calibration); without it, custom ROI calibration on the KPI.

coord_to_columns.description: Meridian's role → the CSV column(s) holding it.

time.description: Date column, yyyy-mm-dd, one row per period (and geo).

geo.description: Geo column. Leave out for a national model.

kpi.description: What media moves: sales, conversions, revenue.

revenue_per_kpi.description: Money per KPI unit, with kpi_type: non_revenue.

population.description: Population per geo. Reset to 1 in a national model.

controls.description: What moves the KPI that media does not: seasonality, price, distribution.

media.description: Execution per channel: impressions, GRP, clicks. Pair with media_spend and the *_to_channel maps.

media_spend.description: Spend per media channel, same channels as media.

non_media_treatments.description: Levers that are not media: price, promotions, discount.

organic_media.description: Unpaid media: blog posts, emails, organic social.

media_to_channel.description: Each media column → its channel's name. Required with media.

media_spend_to_channel.description: Each media_spend column → the same channel names as media_to_channel.
